## Purpose

Describe the teaching, research or engineering need.

## Scope and validity

- What is implemented vs proposed?
- Which assumptions, units, sources or validity boundaries changed?
- Are media rights and attribution documented?

## Verification

- [ ] Formatting, integrity, analytical tests and production build pass
- [ ] Relevant browser/manual checks performed
- [ ] Documentation and model limitations updated
- [ ] No student data, secrets or generated build output included

## Reproduction and evidence

Provide commands, device details and appropriately bounded results.
